messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to nail down a staged preemption + per-tenant throttling approach for Dedicated. Customer asks: deterministic p95 latency during spikes, but also want burst credits.

marc: +1. Two things to clarify: 1) Do we enforce hard caps (reject) or soft throttles (queued/delayed)? 2) How visible do we make burst state to tenants?

elaine: Customers prefer graceful degradation (soft) but legal/sales want explicit SLAs for when we will preempt. Proposing: default soft-throttle then if sustained above headroom → preempt to reserved pool. Need a contract window for notice.

sanjay: For reliability, soft-throttle + token-bucket per tenant seems reasonable. Implementation idea: per-tenant rate limiter with burst tokens that refill on a 24h window. When tokens exhausted, mark tenant "burst-exhausted" and gradually throttle new requests. Preemption kicks in only if cluster-level capacity under pressure.

ben: From runtime perf: token-bucket + short queue is fine. But watch KV cache invalidation — heavy throttling spikes can churn cache and increase p99. Suggest keeping a small unthrottled warm-path for cache hits.

ana: Sales: customers LOVE predictable behavior. We need clear t&c lines: burst credit size, refill cadence, and a fallback timeline. Also need a customer-visible dashboard tile for "burst balance".

jess: Legal: add an explicit clause that preemption notifications are operational (not a guarantee). Also need a minimum 72-hour notice for changing burst policies in an existing contract. For pilot we can ship without notice clause but flag in renewals.

marc: Implementation sketch:
```
tenant_limit:
  base_qps: 10
  burst_tokens: 50000
  refill_period: 24h
  soft_throttle_threshold: 0.8
  preempt_threshold: cluster_headroom < 10%
```
Preemption flow: mark tenant, drain long-running sessions, reroute to fallback small-model if available.

sanjay: Ops/alerting: add metrics: tenant.burst.tokens, tenant.throttle.rate, cluster.headroom. Alert if > 5 tenants in preempt state for >5m. Oncall runbook to include rapid rollback.

ana: Pilot asks: 3 mid-market customers + 1 large customer that requested headroom. Need pricing playbook if they want guaranteed burst.

elaine: Launch criteria draft:
- feature gated on Dedicated tenants only
- pilot with telemetry for token usage and p95 latency (2 weeks)
- dashboard tile + billing-event for burst usage
- legal signoff for renewed contracts
- rollback plan in place (feature flag + throttling off)

marc: Risks: edge fairness (tenants gaming token refill), cache p99 spike, complexity in routing fallback models. Mitigation: cap effective burst by tenant percentile, add random jitter to refill, and limit number of concurrent fallback sessions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment /preempt-service v0.9 queued by marc — ETA 09:15

ben: Can we simulate synthetic bursts today? I can run a workload generator to validate cache behavior and p99 before pilot.

elaine: Please do. Sanjay/Marc coordinate on metrics/export names. Ana — start pilot contract drafts with optional paid guaranteed-burst add-on.

sanjay: Will add metrics and a Grafana dashboard. Marc — I'll pair on the runbook tomorrow.

jess: I'll draft the contract clause language and share in a thread.

ana: Adding here the customer list who signed up: AcmePay, FitSoft, HealthSuite. I'll DM details.

elaine: Thanks all — I'll collate and make a short PRD with the config defaults and launch checklist. Aim to ship pilot next month.

marc: ack. I'll post the proto RFC in #eng-platform when it's ready.

sanjay: ack.
